texts.preamble: Shripal Prakashchand Bora @ Gotu vs State Of Mah., Thr. Pso Ps Digras Tq ... on 28 August, 2019 Author: V. M. Deshpande Bench: V.M. Deshpande 1 aba582.19.odt In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Nagpur Bench, Nagpur. Criminal Application (Aba) No.582/2019 Shripal Prakashchand Bora alias Gotu .vs. State of Maharashtra through Pso P.S. Digras, Tq. Digras, Dist. Yavatmal. _______________________________________________________________________ Office Notes, Office Memoramda of Coram, appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's orders. and Registrar's Orders. Mr. S. S. Doifode, A.P.P. for non applicant-State. Coram : V. M. Deshpande, J. Dated : August 28, 2019
texts.facts: As per FIR, a Bolero pick-up van was intercepted on Darwha road and when it was searched, it was found that it was having pan masala, gutkha, etc., which are banned articles in the State of Maharashtra. FIR further shows that ::: Uploaded on - 28/08/2019 ::: Downloaded on - 29/08/2 2 aba582.19.odt the driver of said vehicle is one Shaikh Jakir Shaikh Gaffar. As per the FIR, said driver, on the spot stated that it is his business and contraband is procured by him for himself to distribute and sell in the market. Application for anticipatory bail is being opposed by learned A.P.P. on the basis of the statement of Shaikh Jakir Shaikh Gaffar, the arrested accused, in which he claimed that contraband belongs to present applicant. When the driver was not arrested that time, he made a statement that contraband belongs to him, whereas after his arrest, when he was under the thumb of police officer and his statement is recorded, he claimed that the contraband belongs to applicant. That is the solitary piece of evidence against the present applicant. The learned A.P.P., on a pointed query made by the Court, informed that, after business establishment of the present applicant was searched, nothing objectionable was found in his business establishment. Also, applicant is not having any past criminal record.
